findings.note: Co-sponsorship, not authorship: the official bill text reads 'By: Representatives Ridley of the 6th, Rhodes of the 124th, Burchett of the 176th, Williams of the 148th, Ridley of the 22nd, and others', and LegiList lists Jordan Ridley among the six cosponsors with Jason Ridley (District 6) as primary sponsor. The bill (Georgia Firearms Industry Nondiscrimination Act) bars financial institutions from using a firearms retailer code, and bars governments or persons from keeping registries of firearms or firearm owners. The date is the introduction date shown by LegiList (https://legilist.com/states/georgia/bill/1031/hb-1018); the official PDF carries no date.
